cardEffects:
[When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, return 1 of their suspended Tamers to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] For each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards, it gets +1000 DP. While your opponent has no Digimon with equal or higher DP, this Digimon gets ＜Piercing＞  (When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends.) and ＜Security A. +1＞  (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

name: Callismon

rulings.answer: Yes, you can use ＜Piercing＞ to perform a security check.  As soon as this card deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, the ＜Piercing＞ gained from this card's [Your Turn] effect and the deleted Digimon's [On Deletion] effect will trigger simultaneously, then the turn player's ＜Piercing＞ will activate first.  When ＜Piercing＞ activates, "perform check before End of Attack timing" processing will be pending, and the check will be performed immediately before the End of Attack timing, even if ＜Piercing＞ is lost after activation.
rulings.question: My opponent has no Digimon with as much or more DP as this card in the battle area.  I used this card to attack an opponent's Digimon, and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in the battle.  Then, if an [On Deletion] effect on the deleted opponent's Digimon activates and my opponent now has a Digimon with as much or more DP as this Digimon, can I use the gained ＜Piercing＞ to perform a security check?

rulings.answer: No, a 2nd security check can't be performed using that ＜Security A. +1＞.  The ＜Security A. +1＞ gained from this card's [Your Turn] effect is lost as soon as your opponent has a Digimon with as much or more DP as this card, therefore you can't use the gained ＜Security A. +1＞ to perform a security check.
rulings.question: My opponent has no Digimon with as much or more DP as this card in the battle area.  This card performs a security check, the [Security] effect on the 1st card checked activates, and my opponent now has a Digimon with as much or more DP as this card.  Can I then use the ＜Security A. +1＞ gained from this card's [Your Turn] effect to perform a 2nd security check?
